name: svet-engine
description: Svet: Production-Ready Hybrid TypeScript + Rust WebAssembly + GPU (UMA/DUMA) UI Framework

scripts.build:wasm: cd crates/svet-wasm && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node ../../scripts/embed-wasm.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
